children: Thailand’s annual inflation rate accelerated for the first time in four months to 2.53% in August 2026, from 1.95% in July, surpassing market expectations of 2.2% and marking the fastest increase since May.
However, the latest reading remained within the Bank of Thailand’s 1%-3% target range.

Meanwhile, the annual core inflation rate, which excludes volatile energy and fresh food prices, accelerated to 1.44% in August 2026 from 1.34% in July, marking the highest reading since May 2023 and exceeding forecasts of 1.33%.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.56%, rebounding from a 0.73% decline in July, marking the fastest increase in four months.

title: Thailand Inflation Rate at 3-Month High
